verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter documents a secure online portal where clients and attorneys upload and review documents together, communicate in one place instead of scattered emails, and track case status. That covers the upload and anti-email parts of the story, but there is no evidence of structured checklists or automated reminders for evidence collection. Missing for 10: document checklists, automated reminders, any independent or hands-on corroboration of the portal workflow.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, evidence and document collection runs through a structured workflow (checklists, uploads, reminders) rather than email attachments

citations.quote: our secure online portal, where you and your attorney can upload and review documents together, communicate directly in one place instead of scattered emails, and track your case status
